# VideoToQuiz AI (https://www.videotoquiz.com)
> AI-Powered Educational Intelligence: Convert YouTube Videos into Interactive Active Recall Quizzes & Flashcards.

## Overview
VideoToQuiz AI is an ad-free educational platform that ingests public YouTube educational video transcripts and lectures to formulate structured, Bloom's Taxonomy-aligned multiple choice assessments and Anki flashcards.

## Core Capabilities
- **Transcript Extraction**: Fetches and parses synchronized YouTube video captions and user lecture transcripts.
- **Active Recall Quizzes**: Generates 5-to-10 question interactive tests with distractors and pedagogical rationale.
- **Timestamped Explanations**: Provides exact video timestamp citations for every correct answer and distractor.
- **Study Flashcard Export**: Formats questions and key takeaways directly into Anki (.txt) and printable PDF review sheets.
- **Peer Challenge Sharing**: Generates instant `/quiz/[id]` challenge URLs for study groups and classrooms.

## Academic Grounding & Methodology
VideoToQuiz AI is designed around empirical principles from cognitive educational psychology:
1. **The Testing Effect (Roediger & Karpicke, 2006)**: Active retrieval practice strengthens long-term neural retention significantly over passive review.
2. **Spacing & Interleaving (Ebbinghaus, 1885; Cepeda et al., 2006)**: Memory decay is interrupted when learners test their retention on spaced intervals.
